about: Sam, in session 2026-11-06 (SkyLantern), after the CPL-AI join named seven certifications filed under another exhibit: 'go ahead and make the seven title fixes in the CER'. Five local titles carry the seven: each was placed by Sam on 2026-10-31 in Review (slee@cccco.edu) under a title the aligned course proposed, and each moves to the credential it names, the way the Exhibits tab's Change to Proposed Title moves one: a guarded replace of its unified_title_assignment beside unified_title_supersedes naming the title it replaces, so the nightly fold's revise lane re-points it. ACE's Personal Trainer Certification leaves Personal Training Certification (which keeps its one generic local title, MAPICA-PTC-1-001); ACSM-CPT and NASM-CPT leave Personal Trainer Instructor, which retires; the State Water Board's wastewater grades II to V and IV or V leave Wastewater Treatment 1 and 2, whose credential records move with them. The issuer rows Sam saved stay as they are: each already names the right issuer. New titles follow the issuers' own names (the CPL-AI catalog's), and the wastewater titles say what the local titles accept: a grade and any higher one. A local fold preview (kb/_fold_unclassified.py on the overlay as the sync would write it): 5 revise, 0 held, 2 credential moves, 1 retire, 3 adds, V2 and V3 OK. Then, the same session: 'go ahead and fold the duplicate ServSafe Manager exhibit'. ServSafe Food Protection Manager holds one local title, VFOOD 210 (a prep course for the exam), classified by machine on 2026-05-20 and never reviewed; ServSafe Food Protection Manager Certification holds four, one placed by map@rccd.edu. A unified_title_override with its merge confirm folds the first into the second; cred-rename-apply.yml carries it and keeps the old title as an alias.
ruling: Sam Lee, in session 2026-11-06 (SkyLantern, the Library side session): 'go ahead and make the seven title fixes in the CER'; superseding his own 2026-10-31 Review saves by his word; and 'go ahead and fold the duplicate ServSafe Manager exhibit' (same session)
